lines.text: I bent down to pick up the cat on Sunday and something went in my back.
Any numbness in the legs, or anything odd with going to the toilet?
I haven't had any numbness, and going to the toilet is normal.
I'm getting a bit of tingling down the back of my left leg, or it might be the right, it swaps about.
It's probably the nerve being a bit irritated rather than anything serious, I'd guess, but I'll keep an eye on it.
You're going to take ibuprofen 400 milligrams three times a day after food, for five days.
Keep moving gently, short walks every couple of hours, bed rest will make it worse.
Right, off you go, see you next week.
Hi. I'm coming in with a sore heel, it's worst first thing.
